Let <MATH_0001> be a functor.
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> Suppose all finite limits exist in <MATH_0002>.
We say <MATH_0003> is <TEXTITOPEN_0001>left exact<TEXTITCLOSE_0001> if it commutes
with all finite limits.
<STRUCT_0003> Suppose all finite colimits exist in <MATH_0004>.
We say <MATH_0005> is <TEXTITOPEN_0002>right exact<TEXTITCLOSE_0002> if it commutes
with all finite colimits.
<STRUCT_0004> We say <MATH_0006> is <TEXTITOPEN_0003>exact<TEXTITCLOSE_0003> if it is both left and right
exact.
